data.title: Overview
data.markdown:
**demo-api** is a small REST service built with **Express**. It exposes CRUD endpoints for notes and persists them in a JSON file.

- Language: JavaScript (Node 18+)
- Tests: Jest
- Entry point: `src/index.js`

data.summary: Found 4 open issues labelled good first issue

data.title: Architecture
data.markdown:
Requests enter through `src/index.js`, pass through logging and validation middleware, and reach route handlers in `src/routes/`. Handlers call the storage layer in `src/store.js`, which reads and writes `data/notes.json`.

1. **Routes** parse input and shape responses.
2. **Middleware** handles logging, errors and validation.
3. **Store** is the only module that touches the filesystem.

data.markdown:
graph TD
  Client[HTTP Client] --> Index[src/index.js]
  Index --> MW[Middleware]
  MW --> Routes[src/routes]
  Routes --> Store[src/store.js]
  Store --> JSON[(data/notes.json)]

data.title: Run it locally
data.markdown:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/demo/demo-api.git
cd demo-api
npm install
npm start
```

The server listens on `http://localhost:3000`. Run the tests with `npm test`.
